notes.subject: נבוב / ילבב
notes.rationale: pun on 'hollow' and 'get a heart' — the hollow man gets a heart; bel keeps the לב picture in Tok Pisin

notes.subject: taim ... i bon olsem man
notes.rationale: read as impossible condition 'only when a wild ass's colt is born a man' (JPS/BSB) or as plain statement 'man is born like a wild ass's colt' (KJV/ASV)

notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לבב rendered bel, the seat of thinking and wanting, not the body organ

translation: Olsem na man holsam i ken kisim bel, taim pikinini donki bilong wail donki i bon olsem man.
